instruction.text: Read this diary entry about Josh’s first day at his new school, and select all the simple past tense verbs.

atoms.b:
I ((was)) at my new secondary school today. I ((met)) lots of new kids and teachers. I ((made)) a new friend in maths. His name is Rahul.
Rahul ((told)) me he likes video games. I ((invited)) Rahul to come over after school and play video games with me. Overall, I ((enjoyed)) my first day.
